{{Top|leg|title=Unidentified ''Tzarina'' survivor}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
{{Quote|I am the last survivor of a crashed cruise liner, the Star Tours Tzarina. If you promise to tell others of our fate, I will tell you where the wreckage is. Perhaps you can find something salvageable there. Agreed?|The survivor, to a passing-by spacer|<ref name="SWG:ac">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|a commoner|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
A being that lived at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] was the last known survivor of the crashed [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] [[Passenger liner/Legends|starliner]] ''[[Tzarina]]''.<ref name="SWG:ac" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|I was one of many who were lucky enough to be some of the first passengers on Star Tours newest luxury yacht. Everything was fine until the droid captain changed course towards Yavin to show us something "neat". The ship was hit by a strange T.I.E. Fighter that was tumbling out of control. Our hyperdrive initiated and drove us straight into this planet. You must let others know...|The survivor, to a passing-by spacer|<ref name="SWG:ac">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|a commoner|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
[[File:TzarinaCrash.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The wreckage of the ''[[Tzarina]]''.]]
Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], this being was among the first passengers on Star Tours' newest luxury cruise liner, the ''Tzarina''. But when the droid captain changed course towards [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]], the ship was hit by an [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced/Legends|unidentified TIE Fighter]] that was tumbling out of control. The cruise liner's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] initiated and threw the ship into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. When it fell out of hyperspace half a galaxy away, the ship crashed onto the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]].<ref name="SWG:ac" />

An unknown number of beings survived the crash, however only this being managed to survive long enough in the dangerous Dathomirian wilderness to reach the [[Trade Outpost]],<ref name="SWG:ac" /> months later.<ref name="CDD">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref> There the survivor met a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who promised to tell others of the passenger's fate in exchanged for the coordinates of the crashed cruiser.<ref name="SWG:ac" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of the commoner]]
The ''Tzarina'' survivor was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ac" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The ''Tzarina'' survivor was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]" update, released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref>

The NPC was named "a commoner", a typical designation for the many randomly generated generic NPCs that populated the cities in the game. It pointed players to the location of the [[:w:c:swg:Dathomir Crash Site|crashed starship]]. By agreeing to tell others of the ship's fate, a [[:w:c:swg:Waypoint|waypoint]] to the crash site is added to the player's datapad. The appearance, gender and species of this NPC changed with every server restart.<ref name="SWG:ac" />

The unusual TIE fighter mentioned by the survivor was possibly a reference to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]'s [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced/Legends|TIE Advanced]], which was sent tumbling out of control during the Battle of Yavin.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
